name: explorium
description: Search, match and enrich B2B companies and prospects, and read business event signals, from Explorium's live data platform.

authentication.description: Connect through an MCP client that supports OAuth. The server issues an authorization challenge on initialize.

tools.name: fetch-entities
tools.description: Find companies or prospects using firmographic, technographic, role and intent filters.

tools.name: match-business
tools.description: Resolve a company name and/or domain to an Explorium business ID in bulk.

tools.name: match-prospects
tools.description: Resolve a person (email, or full name plus company) to an Explorium prospect ID.

tools.name: enrich-business
tools.description: Add firmographics, technographics, funding, financials, workforce trends and related attributes to matched companies.

tools.name: enrich-prospects
tools.description: Add contact details and professional profiles to matched prospects.

tools.name: fetch-businesses-events
tools.description: Retrieve business event signals such as funding rounds, hiring changes, new products and acquisitions.

tools.name: fetch-prospects-events
tools.description: Retrieve prospect-level events such as role changes and company moves.

tools.name: fetch-entities-statistics
tools.description: Return aggregate statistics describing how a filtered audience is distributed.

tools.name: autocomplete
tools.description: Resolve free-text input to the standardized filter values the search API accepts.

tools.name: estimate-cost
tools.description: Estimate the credit cost of an operation before it is run.

tools.name: show-sample
tools.description: Preview sample rows from a result table before exporting.

tools.name: export-to-csv
tools.description: Export a prepared result table to CSV.

tools.name: show-pricing-plans
tools.description: Show the available credit packages and their pricing.
